name: Beğendik Bridge
facts: Beğendik Bridge, Turkey's highest and longest main‑span bridge, opened to traffic on July 11, 2020, after a 2020 inauguration that marked the culmination of a decade‑long construction saga.
The 450‑meter, 14‑meter wide suspension bridge boasts a 210‑meter central span, the longest balanced cantilever span in Turkey, and towers 165 meters above the Botan River gorge.

Construction setbacks in 2017 and 2018—when a 50‑meter beam fell and the north pier collapsed—delayed the project, yet the bridge was finally completed in November 2019, cutting travel time between Van and Pervari from five hours to two.
